svg.title: Kyoto at your own pace: seventeen places around Okazaki and Higashiyama
svg.desc: North-up simplified map with an approximate scale. Zero is the dinner venue. Numbers group nearby places: 1–3 north of the venue, 4–8 central Okazaki, 9–12 Keage and Nanzen-ji, 13–16 Shirakawa and Gion. Colours indicate types of stops, not areas. One to sixteen are museums, canals, temples and shrines, a riverside bridge, a former boat railway, books, cafés, shopping and crafts. Each number opens place information in Google Maps. Heian Jingu shrine is labelled separately from the dinner venue (zero). Distances are approximate and one way. Outdoor views and free grounds are distinguished from paid visits. Admission deadlines apply to the specified museum or paid visit; cafes and temple gates have separate hours. Closely spaced places have leader lines to their geographic positions. Roads, river and shrine precinct use the same geographic projection as the locations. Colored lines A and B show suggested walking segments from the public walking network, not the waterway itself.
svg.text: Walk the neighbourhood, browse local crafts, or pause for coffee, Kyoto beer or sake.
Places by area · 0 is the dinner venue

a.aria-label: 0 · Heian Jingu Kaikan; Reference point; Dinner venue: Heian Jingu Kaikan (平安神宮会館), beside the shrine. Final meeting time and event arrangements will be announced separately.
a.title: 0 · Heian Jingu Kaikan; Reference point; Dinner venue: Heian Jingu Kaikan (平安神宮会館), beside the shrine. Final meeting time and event arrangements will be announced separately.

a.aria-label: 1 · Kyoto Handicraft Center; ~0.6 km; 9–12 min; Browse Japanese crafts and gifts. March–December 10:00–19:00. Workshops are separately booked.
a.title: 1 · Kyoto Handicraft Center; ~0.6 km; 9–12 min; Browse Japanese crafts and gifts. March–December 10:00–19:00. Workshops are separately booked.

a.aria-label: 2 · KYOTO ROKURO; ~150 m; 3–5 min; Japanese tea and an antique gallery near Heian Jingu. 10:00–18:00; last order 17:30. Closed Tuesdays and Wednesdays.
a.title: 2 · KYOTO ROKURO; ~150 m; 3–5 min; Japanese tea and an antique gallery near Heian Jingu. 10:00–18:00; last order 17:30. Closed Tuesdays and Wednesdays.

a.aria-label: 3 · Okazaki Shrine; northeast of Heian Jingu; Rabbit statues and a small, quiet shrine precinct. A short outdoor stop northeast of Heian Jingu. Visit in daylight and follow local access notices.
a.title: 3 · Okazaki Shrine; northeast of Heian Jingu; Rabbit statues and a small, quiet shrine precinct. A short outdoor stop northeast of Heian Jingu. Visit in daylight and follow local access notices.
a.text: Northeast of Heian Jingu · short stop

a.aria-label: 4 · 58DINER; ~0.6 km; 8–11 min; A casual diner with craft beer, sweets and food. Open from 11:00; closed Mondays. Official pages differ on evening closing time; check the current shop information.
a.title: 4 · 58DINER; ~0.6 km; 8–11 min; A casual diner with craft beer, sweets and food. Open from 11:00; closed Mondays. Official pages differ on evening closing time; check the current shop information.

a.aria-label: 5 · Tsutaya Books / Modern Terrace / Starbucks; ~0.4 km; 5–7 min; Books 10:00–20:00; Modern Terrace 11:00–22:00 serves coffee, Kyoto craft beer and sake (drink orders until 21:00); Starbucks 08:00–22:00 with irregular holidays. Same Park Plaza building.
a.title: 5 · Tsutaya Books / Modern Terrace / Starbucks; ~0.4 km; 5–7 min; Books 10:00–20:00; Modern Terrace 11:00–22:00 serves coffee, Kyoto craft beer and sake (drink orders until 21:00); Starbucks 08:00–22:00 with irregular holidays. Same Park Plaza building.

a.aria-label: 6 · Kyoto Museum of Crafts and Design / Miyakomesse; ~0.5 km; 6–9 min + indoors; Indoor crafts museum on B1 of Miyakomesse. Open 10:00–18:00; museum admission until 17:30. Building arrival reference on the north side; allow time to reach B1. Adult admission JPY500.
a.title: 6 · Kyoto Museum of Crafts and Design / Miyakomesse; ~0.5 km; 6–9 min + indoors; Indoor crafts museum on B1 of Miyakomesse. Open 10:00–18:00; museum admission until 17:30. Building arrival reference on the north side; allow time to reach B1. Adult admission JPY500.

a.aria-label: 7 · KYOCERA Museum / ENFUSE; ~0.4 km; 6–8 min; Museum galleries: 10:00–18:00, last admission 17:30. ENFUSE cafe has separate hours: 10:30–19:00, last orders 18:00.
a.title: 7 · KYOCERA Museum / ENFUSE; ~0.4 km; 6–8 min; Museum galleries: 10:00–18:00, last admission 17:30. ENFUSE cafe has separate hours: 10:30–19:00, last orders 18:00.

a.aria-label: 8 · Keiryu Bridge / Okazaki Canal; ~0.5 km; 7–9 min; Waterside walk and views of the great torii. Use public paths.
a.title: 8 · Keiryu Bridge / Okazaki Canal; ~0.5 km; 7–9 min; Waterside walk and views of the great torii. Use public paths.

a.aria-label: 9 · Lake Biwa Canal Museum; ~0.8 km; 11–13 min; Indoor canal museum: 09:00–17:00, last admission 16:30. The nearby canal walks are separate outdoor stops.
a.title: 9 · Lake Biwa Canal Museum; ~0.8 km; 11–13 min; Indoor canal museum: 09:00–17:00, last admission 16:30. The nearby canal walks are separate outdoor stops.

a.aria-label: 10 · Keage Incline / lower end; ~0.7 km; 10–13 min; Arrival point at the northern lower end of the former boat railway. The full slope takes extra time. Visit while light and follow access notices.
a.title: 10 · Keage Incline / lower end; ~0.7 km; 10–13 min; Arrival point at the northern lower end of the former boat railway. The full slope takes extra time. Visit while light and follow access notices.

a.aria-label: 11 · Blue Bottle Coffee Kyoto Cafe; ~0.9 km; 12–15 min; A seated coffee break near Nanzen-ji; 44 seats. Open daily 08:00–18:00. This is the main cafe, not the reservation-only Lounge.
a.title: 11 · Blue Bottle Coffee Kyoto Cafe; ~0.9 km; 12–15 min; A seated coffee break near Nanzen-ji; 44 seats. Open daily 08:00–18:00. This is the main cafe, not the reservation-only Lounge.

a.aria-label: 12 · Nanzen-ji Sanmon area; ~1.2 km; 16–20 min; Free outdoor grounds: see the Sanmon gate exterior and continue to the Suirokaku aqueduct. Paid visits only: last admission 16:10, close 16:30 in December. Distance is to Sanmon; the aqueduct is a further walk. Visit while light and follow local access notices.
a.title: 12 · Nanzen-ji Sanmon area; ~1.2 km; 16–20 min; Free outdoor grounds: see the Sanmon gate exterior and continue to the Suirokaku aqueduct. Paid visits only: last admission 16:10, close 16:30 in December. Distance is to Sanmon; the aqueduct is a further walk. Visit while light and follow local access notices.

a.aria-label: 13 · Furukawacho Arcade / BEER Komachi; ~1.1 km; 15–18 min; Walk through the shopping arcade; individual shops have their own hours. BEER Komachi opens 17:00 on weekdays; a pub visit is better after dinner.
a.title: 13 · Furukawacho Arcade / BEER Komachi; ~1.1 km; 15–18 min; Walk through the shopping arcade; individual shops have their own hours. BEER Komachi opens 17:00 on weekdays; a pub visit is better after dinner.

a.aria-label: 14 · Shirakawa / Ipponbashi bridge; ~1.3 km; 18–22 min; A small stone bridge, willows and riverside streets. Enjoy the view without needing to cross the narrow bridge.
a.title: 14 · Shirakawa / Ipponbashi bridge; ~1.3 km; 18–22 min; A small stone bridge, willows and riverside streets. Enjoy the view without needing to cross the narrow bridge.

a.aria-label: 15 · Chion-in Sanmon gate front; ~1.3 km; 18–22 min; See the Sanmon exterior from the public approach outside the temple gates. This stop does not require entering the grounds. Temple gates close 16:00 per the Japanese guide; the Sanmon interior is not normally open.
a.title: 15 · Chion-in Sanmon gate front; ~1.3 km; 18–22 min; See the Sanmon exterior from the public approach outside the temple gates. This stop does not require entering the grounds. Temple gates close 16:00 per the Japanese guide; the Sanmon interior is not normally open.

a.aria-label: 16 · Gion Yamaneko Kyoto Sake & Beer; ~1.7 km; 23–28 min; Kyoto sake and craft beer in Gion. Usual hours 13:00–23:00; last order 22:30. A longer walk or after-dinner option; allow time to return.
